items.title: Support @tiffanyleeproject on TikTok
items.content_html: Directly support @tiffanyleeproject on TikTok. This open-ended creator cause lets fans and community members send transparent, on-chain support/tips directly to the creator's verified Base wallet after TikTok ownership is confirmed. No A/B voting, no protocol fee, no custody by Polytab.

_polytab.plainSummary:
Creator: @tiffanyleeproject (TikTok) — https://www.tiktok.com/@tiffanyleeproject

What this is: An open-ended Community & Creator Cause for direct support/tips. Supporters can back the creator transparently on-chain once the page is verified.

How it unlocks: Creator confirms TikTok ownership with Polytab Login Kit, then signs and attaches a verified Base payout wallet (chain 8453).

Proof / source: TikTok profile https://www.tiktok.com/@tiffanyleeproject · Featured post https://www.tiktok.com/@tiffanyleeproject/video/7710755794362305805

Status: Locked pending creator verification (TikTok + wallet). Honest-zero until verified on-chain receipts.
